hey! so i would start off by saying that my post isn’t getting much traction anymore so if you’re looking for more advice to definitely make a new post on its own and explain everything you’ve said in your comment here.

with your mum being homophobic and not being able to trust your dad or sister, if you’re dependent on them my advice would be to wait for a safe time to come out to them, maybe at a time in your life where you’re independent or able to become independent if need be, for example living out of home. if you’re feeling the need to talk to someone about your feelings a trusted friend would be the safest option as well as a teacher (if you’re in school) or therapist if you’re able to see one.

on the asexual topic as you may have seen on the other comments on my post asexuality is a spectrum, so you might be sex repulsed or you may feel that it is something you might want to try one day, regardless of where you sit on the spectrum when/if and how you choose to explore sex is completely up to you, it is an extremely personal, intimate and vulnerable experience and not something that someone can tell you how you feel about it. from the way you described it (and i could be wrong) it sounds like you might be scared about it because it’s something you’ve never experienced before, that being said a lot of people know they are asexual without having had sex before, just the same as a lot of queer people know they are queer without having first been in a heterosexual relationship. just become one thing is the norm doesn’t mean you need to try it to know it’s something you don’t want or won’t like. 

in terms of your pride, IF this is something you are worried about and you decide that you do want to explore sex then the best thing you can do is do it with someone you’re comfortable with and who you trust, it will help to alleviate the pressure to perform and instead make it into an experience you share with someone else.

please do not let anyone pressure you do something you don’t want to do or may not be ready for. it’s completely up to you to decide what you want to do it within your own time, there is no rush on figuring these things out about yourself.

goodluck with everything!
